en.name: Wizard
en.description: An Intelligence-based full spellcaster who records spells in a spellbook and prepares them after a Long Rest.

ru.name: Волшебник
ru.description: Полный заклинатель на Интеллекте, записывающий заклинания в книгу и подготавливающий их после продолжительного отдыха.

en.name: Evoker
en.description: A Wizard specialization focused on elemental Evocation spells and protecting allies from those effects.

ru.name: Воплощающий
ru.description: Специализация волшебника на стихийных заклинаниях Воплощения и защите союзников от их эффектов.

en.name: Spellcasting
en.description: Know three Wizard cantrips, keep level 1+ Wizard spells in a spellbook, prepare spells from that book, and use Intelligence for Wizard spells. The spellbook starts with six level 1 Wizard spells and gains two eligible Wizard spells whenever a Wizard level is gained after level 1.

ru.name: Использование заклинаний
ru.description: Вы знаете три заговора волшебника, храните заклинания 1+ уровня в книге, подготавливаете их из книги и используете Интеллект. В начале книга содержит шесть заклинаний волшебника 1 уровня; после каждого следующего уровня волшебника в неё добавляются два доступных заклинания.

choices.filter: entityType == spell && spellLevel == 0 && spellClassIds contains srd52.class.wizard
entityType == spell && spellLevel == 1 && spellClassIds contains srd52.class.wizard

effects.notes: Add two Wizard spells after every Wizard level beyond 1.

en.name: Ritual Adept
en.description: Cast a Wizard spell as a Ritual when it has the Ritual tag and is in your spellbook; it need not be prepared.

ru.name: Знаток ритуалов
ru.description: Позволяет сотворять ритуалом заклинание волшебника с тегом «Ритуал», если оно записано в книге; подготавливать его не требуется.

en.name: Arcane Recovery
en.description: After a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your Wizard level, rounded up. No recovered slot can be level 6 or higher. Once per Long Rest.

ru.name: Магическое восстановление
ru.description: После короткого отдыха восстанавливает потраченные ячейки суммарным уровнем не выше половины уровня волшебника с округлением вверх. Ячейки 6+ уровня восстановить нельзя. Один раз до продолжительного отдыха.

effects.notes: Select slots with combined levels up to the formula; no slot may be level 6+.

en.name: Scholar
en.description: Choose Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion in which you are proficient; gain Expertise in that skill.

ru.name: Учёный
ru.description: Выберите Аркану, Историю, Анализ, Медицину, Природу или Религию, которой уже владеете; получите компетентность в выбранном навыке.

en.name: Wizard Subclass
en.description: Choose a Wizard subclass and gain its features at the listed Wizard levels.

ru.name: Подкласс волшебника
ru.description: Выберите подкласс волшебника и получайте его умения на указанных уровнях волшебника.

en.name: Ability Score Improvement
en.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Wizard gains this at levels 4, 8, 12, and 16.

ru.name: Улучшение характеристик
ru.description: Получите черту «Улучшение характеристик» или другую доступную черту. Волшебник получает это умение на уровнях 4, 8, 12 и 16.

en.name: Memorize Spell
en.description: After a Short Rest, replace one prepared level 1+ Wizard spell with another level 1+ spell from your spellbook.

ru.name: Запоминание заклинания
ru.description: После короткого отдыха замените одно подготовленное заклинание волшебника 1+ уровня другим заклинанием 1+ уровня из своей книги.

en.name: Spell Mastery
en.description: Choose one level 1 and one level 2 action spell in your spellbook. They are always prepared and can be cast at their lowest level without a spell slot. Choices can change after a Long Rest.

ru.name: Мастерство заклинаний
ru.description: Выберите в книге одно заклинание 1 уровня и одно 2 уровня со временем сотворения «Действие». Они всегда подготовлены и могут сотворяться на минимальном уровне без ячейки. После продолжительного отдыха выбор можно заменить.

effects.notes: Applies only to the two selected spells at their lowest level.

en.name: Epic Boon
en.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify. Boon of Spell Recall is recommended.

ru.name: Эпическая черта
ru.description: Получите эпическую черту или другую доступную черту. Рекомендована «Черта возврата заклинания».

en.name: Signature Spells
en.description: Choose two level 3 spells in your spellbook. They are always prepared, and each can be cast once at level 3 without a spell slot; each use returns after a Short or Long Rest.

ru.name: Фирменные заклинания
ru.description: Выберите два заклинания 3 уровня из книги. Они всегда подготовлены, и каждое можно один раз сотворить на 3 уровне без ячейки; использования восстанавливаются после короткого или продолжительного отдыха.

effects.notes: Track one free level-3 cast separately for each selected spell.

en.name: Evocation Savant
en.description: Add two level 0–2 Evocation Wizard spells to your spellbook for free. Whenever this class first grants a higher spell-slot level, add one eligible Evocation Wizard spell for free.

ru.name: Знаток воплощения
ru.description: Бесплатно добавьте в книгу два заклинания волшебника школы Воплощения не выше 2 уровня. Каждый раз при первом получении нового уровня ячеек этого класса бесплатно добавляйте одно доступное заклинание Воплощения.

choices.filter: entityType == spell && schoolId == spell_school.evocation && spellLevel <= 2 && spellClassIds contains srd52.class.wizard

effects.trigger: when a new Wizard spell-slot level becomes available

en.name: Potent Cantrip
en.description: When your damaging cantrip misses or its target succeeds on the saving throw, the target takes half the cantrip's damage and suffers no additional effect.

ru.name: Мощный заговор
ru.description: Если атакующий заговор с уроном промахивается или цель преуспевает в спасброске, цель получает половину урона заговора без дополнительных эффектов.

en.name: Sculpt Spells
en.description: When an Evocation spell affects visible creatures, protect up to 1 + the spell's level of them. They automatically succeed on their saves and take no damage when a successful save would normally halve damage.

ru.name: Формирование заклинаний
ru.description: Когда заклинание Воплощения затрагивает видимых существ, защитите до 1 + уровня заклинания из них. Они автоматически преуспевают в спасбросках и не получают урон, если успех обычно уменьшает его вдвое.

en.name: Empowered Evocation
en.description: When you cast a Wizard Evocation spell, add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

ru.name: Усиленное воплощение
ru.description: При сотворении заклинания волшебника школы Воплощения добавьте модификатор Интеллекта к одному броску урона этого заклинания.

en.name: Overchannel
en.description: For a damaging Wizard spell cast with a level 1–5 slot, maximize its damage on the casting turn. The first use before a Long Rest is safe; later uses deal escalating unavoidable Necrotic damage per slot level.

ru.name: Перегрузка
ru.description: Максимизируйте урон наносящего урон заклинания волшебника, сотворённого ячейкой 1–5 уровня, в ход сотворения. Первое применение до продолжительного отдыха безопасно; повторные наносят растущий некротический урон за уровень ячейки, который нельзя уменьшить.

effects.trigger: on each use after the first before a Long Rest
effects.notes: Increase the damage per slot level by 1d12 after each repeated use.

en.description: Acolyte background from SRD 5.2.1 with its ability choices, Origin feat, proficiencies, and complete equipment package.

ru.name: Прислужник
ru.description: Предыстория «Прислужник» из SRD 5.2.1 с выбором характеристик, чертой происхождения, владениями и полным набором снаряжения.

en.name: Alert
en.description: Add Proficiency Bonus to Initiative; immediately after rolling Initiative, you may swap it with a willing ally who is not Incapacitated.

ru.name: Бдительный
ru.description: Добавляйте БМ к инициативе; сразу после броска можете обменяться инициативой с согласным союзником без состояния «Недееспособен».

en.name: Magic Initiate
en.description: Choose the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list, learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from it, choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, and cast the level 1 spell free once per Long Rest. Each repeat must use a different list.

ru.name: Посвящённый в магию
ru.description: Выберите список жреца, друида или волшебника, изучите два заговора и заклинание 1 уровня, выберите Интеллект, Мудрость или Харизму и раз в продолжительный отдых сотворяйте заклинание 1 уровня бесплатно. При повторе выбирайте другой список.

entities.repeatConstraint: Each selection must use a spell list not chosen by another instance of this feat.

choices.filter: entityType == spell && spellLevel == 0 && spellClassIds contains selected("choice.magic-initiate.list")
entityType == spell && spellLevel == 1 && spellClassIds contains selected("choice.magic-initiate.list")

en.name: Savage Attacker
en.description: Once per turn on a weapon hit, roll the weapon damage dice twice and use either roll.

ru.name: Свирепый атакующий
ru.description: Раз в ход при попадании оружием бросьте его кости урона дважды и выберите результат.

en.name: Skilled
en.description: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

ru.name: Умелый
ru.description: Получите владение любой комбинацией трёх навыков или инструментов.

en.name: Ability Score Improvement
en.description: Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1, to a maximum of 20.

ru.name: Улучшение характеристик
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 2 или две на 1, максимум до 20.

en.name: Grappler
en.description: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (max 20); combine Unarmed Strike damage and grapple once per turn, gain Advantage against creatures you Grapple, and move same-size or smaller Grappled creatures without extra movement.

ru.name: Борец
ru.description: Увеличьте Силу или Ловкость на 1 (макс. 20); раз в ход совмещайте урон безоружного удара и захват, атакуйте захваченных с преимуществом и перемещайте захваченных своего размера или меньше без дополнительных затрат.

en.name: Archery
en.description: Gain +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

ru.name: Стрельба
ru.description: Получите +2 к броскам атаки дальнобойным оружием.

en.name: Defense
en.description: While wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, gain +1 Armor Class.

ru.name: Оборона
ru.description: Пока вы носите лёгкий, средний или тяжёлый доспех, получите +1 к КД.

en.name: Great Weapon Fighting
en.description: Treat 1 or 2 as 3 on damage dice for a Melee weapon held in two hands with Two-Handed or Versatile.

ru.name: Сражение большим оружием
ru.description: Считайте 1 или 2 на кости урона за 3 для рукопашного двуручного или универсального оружия, удерживаемого двумя руками.

en.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
en.description: Add your ability modifier to the extra attack from a Light weapon when it is not already added.

ru.name: Сражение двумя оружиями
ru.description: Добавляйте модификатор характеристики к дополнительной атаке лёгким оружием, если он ещё не добавлен.

en.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30). When an attack misses, make it hit instead; once until the start of your next turn.

ru.name: Дар боевого мастерства
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30). После промаха превратите его в попадание; один раз до начала следующего хода.

en.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30). After the Attack or Magic action, teleport up to 30 feet.

ru.name: Дар пространственного путешествия
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30). После действия «Атака» или «Магия» телепортируйтесь на 30 футов.

en.name: Boon of Fate
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30). After a D20 Test within 60 feet succeeds or fails, apply +2d4 or −2d4; recover after Initiative or a Short/Long Rest.

ru.name: Дар судьбы
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30). После успеха или провала проверки к20 в 60 футах примените +2к4 или −2к4; восстановление после инициативы, короткого или продолжительного отдыха.

en.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
en.description: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (max 30), ignore Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and on a natural 20 deal extra damage equal to the increased ability score.

ru.name: Дар неудержимого нападения
ru.description: Увеличьте Силу или Ловкость на 1 (макс. 30), игнорируйте сопротивление дробящему, колющему и рубящему урону и при натуральной 20 наносите дополнительный урон, равный повышенной характеристике.

en.name: Boon of Spell Recall
en.description: Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1 (max 30). When casting with a level 1–4 slot, roll 1d4; matching the slot level preserves the slot.

ru.name: Дар возврата заклинания
ru.description: Увеличьте Интеллект, Мудрость или Харизму на 1 (макс. 30). При сотворении ячейкой 1–4 уровня бросьте 1к4; при совпадении с уровнем ячейка не тратится.

en.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30). In Dim Light or Darkness become Invisible as a Bonus Action until you take an action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; also resist all damage except Psychic and Radiant there.

ru.name: Дар ночного духа
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30). В тусклом свете или тьме бонусным действием становитесь невидимым до действия, бонусного действия или реакции; там же сопротивляйтесь всему урону кроме психического и излучения.

en.name: Boon of Truesight
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30) and gain 60-foot Truesight.

ru.name: Дар истинного зрения
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30) и получите истинное зрение 60 футов.

en.name: Black Dragon
en.description: Your Breath Weapon deals acid damage, and you have Resistance to that damage type.

ru.name: Чёрный дракон
ru.description: Ваше дыхание наносит урон типа acid, и вы получаете сопротивление этому типу урона.

en.name: Blue Dragon
en.description: Your Breath Weapon deals lightning damage, and you have Resistance to that damage type.

ru.name: Синий дракон
ru.description: Ваше дыхание наносит урон типа lightning, и вы получаете сопротивление этому типу урона.

en.name: Brass Dragon
en.description: Your Breath Weapon deals fire damage, and you have Resistance to that damage type.

ru.name: Латунный дракон
ru.description: Ваше дыхание наносит урон типа fire, и вы получаете сопротивление этому типу урона.

en.description: Your Breath Weapon deals lightning damage, and you have Resistance to that damage type.

ru.name: Бронзовый дракон
ru.description: Ваше дыхание наносит урон типа lightning, и вы получаете сопротивление этому типу урона.

en.description: Your Breath Weapon deals acid damage, and you have Resistance to that damage type.

ru.name: Медный дракон
ru.description: Ваше дыхание наносит урон типа acid, и вы получаете сопротивление этому типу урона.

ru.name: Золотой дракон

en.description: Your Breath Weapon deals poison damage, and you have Resistance to that damage type.

ru.name: Зелёный дракон
ru.description: Ваше дыхание наносит урон типа poison, и вы получаете сопротивление этому типу урона.

en.description: Your Breath Weapon deals fire damage, and you have Resistance to that damage type.

ru.name: Красный дракон
ru.description: Ваше дыхание наносит урон типа fire, и вы получаете сопротивление этому типу урона.

en.description: Your Breath Weapon deals cold damage, and you have Resistance to that damage type.

ru.name: Серебряный дракон
ru.description: Ваше дыхание наносит урон типа cold, и вы получаете сопротивление этому типу урона.

en.name: White Dragon
en.description: Your Breath Weapon deals cold damage, and you have Resistance to that damage type.

ru.name: Белый дракон
ru.description: Ваше дыхание наносит урон типа cold, и вы получаете сопротивление этому типу урона.

en.name: Breath Weapon
en.description: Replace one attack with a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot by 5-foot Line. Creatures make a Dexterity save against 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus; damage is 1d10, scaling to 2d10/3d10/4d10 at character levels 5/11/17, half on a success. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

ru.name: Оружие дыхания
ru.description: Замените одну атаку конусом 15 футов или линией 30 на 5 футов. Спасбросок Ловкости против 8 + модификатор Телосложения + БМ; урон 1к10, растущий до 2к10/3к10/4к10 на уровнях 5/11/17, половина при успехе. Использований равно БМ до продолжительного отдыха.

en.name: Darkvision
en.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

ru.name: Тёмное зрение
ru.description: Вы обладаете тёмным зрением в пределах 60 футов.

en.name: Draconic Flight
en.description: From character level 5, use a Bonus Action to gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes. Once per Long Rest.

ru.name: Драконий полёт
ru.description: С 5 уровня бонусным действием получите скорость полёта, равную вашей скорости, на 10 минут. Один раз до продолжительного отдыха.

en.name: Darkvision
en.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

ru.name: Тёмное зрение
ru.description: Вы обладаете тёмным зрением в пределах 120 футов.

en.name: Dwarven Resilience
en.description: You resist Poison damage and have Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

ru.name: Дворфийская стойкость
ru.description: Вы сопротивляетесь урону ядом и совершаете с преимуществом спасброски против состояния «Отравлен».

en.name: Dwarven Toughness
en.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 now and by 1 whenever you gain a level.

ru.name: Дворфийская выносливость
ru.description: Максимум хитов увеличивается на 1 сейчас и ещё на 1 при каждом получении уровня.

en.name: Stonecunning
en.description: As a Bonus Action while touching stone, gain 60-foot Tremorsense for 10 minutes. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

ru.name: Знание камня
ru.description: Бонусным действием при касании камня получите чувство вибрации 60 футов на 10 минут. Использований равно БМ до продолжительного отдыха.

en.name: Darkvision
en.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

ru.name: Тёмное зрение
ru.description: Вы обладаете тёмным зрением в пределах 60 футов.

en.name: Fey Ancestry
en.description: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

ru.name: Наследие фей
ru.description: Вы совершаете с преимуществом спасброски, чтобы избежать или окончить состояние «Очарован».

en.name: Keen Senses
en.description: Gain proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

ru.name: Обострённые чувства
ru.description: Получите владение Проницательностью, Внимательностью или Выживанием.

en.name: Trance
en.description: You need no sleep, magic cannot put you to sleep, and you can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of conscious meditation.

ru.name: Транс
ru.description: Вам не нужен сон, магия не может усыпить вас, а продолжительный отдых можно завершить за 4 часа осознанной медитации.

en.name: Drow Lineage
en.description: Darkvision becomes 120 feet. You know Dancing Lights and later gain Faerie Fire and Darkness.

ru.name: Наследие дроу
ru.description: Тёмное зрение увеличивается до 120 футов. Вы знаете «Пляшущие огоньки», а затем получаете «Огонь фей» и «Тьму».

en.name: High Elf Lineage
en.description: Know Prestidigitation, replaceable with another Wizard cantrip after a Long Rest; gain Detect Magic at level 3 and Misty Step at level 5.

ru.name: Наследие высшего эльфа
ru.description: Вы знаете «Фокусы» и можете менять их на другой заговор волшебника после продолжительного отдыха; на 3 уровне получаете «Обнаружение магии», на 5 — «Туманный шаг».

en.name: Wood Elf Lineage
en.description: Your Speed is 35 feet. You know Druidcraft and later gain Longstrider and Pass without Trace.

ru.name: Наследие лесного эльфа
ru.description: Ваша скорость 35 футов. Вы знаете «Искусство друидов», а затем получаете «Скорохода» и «Бесследное передвижение».

en.name: Darkvision
en.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

ru.name: Тёмное зрение
ru.description: Вы обладаете тёмным зрением в пределах 60 футов.

en.name: Gnomish Cunning
en.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

ru.name: Гномья хитрость
ru.description: Вы совершаете с преимуществом спасброски Интеллекта, Мудрости и Харизмы.

en.name: Forest Gnome Lineage
en.description: Know Minor Illusion and always have Speak with Animals prepared; cast it without a slot Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

ru.name: Наследие лесного гнома
ru.description: Вы знаете «Малую иллюзию» и всегда подготавливаете «Разговор с животными»; сотворяйте его без ячейки БМ раз до продолжительного отдыха.

en.name: Rock Gnome Lineage
en.description: Know Mending and Prestidigitation. Spend 10 minutes with Prestidigitation to create one of up to three Tiny clockwork devices lasting 8 hours.

ru.name: Наследие скального гнома
ru.description: Вы знаете «Починку» и «Фокусы». За 10 минут с помощью «Фокусов» создавайте до трёх крошечных часовых устройств, существующих 8 часов.

en.name: Cloud’s Jaunt
en.description: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 feet.

ru.name: Облачный скачок
ru.description: Бонусным действием телепортируйтесь на 30 футов.

en.name: Fire’s Burn
en.description: After you hit and deal damage, deal 1d10 extra Fire damage.

ru.name: Пламя огня
ru.description: После попадания и нанесения урона нанесите ещё 1к10 огнём.

en.name: Frost’s Chill
en.description: After a damaging hit, deal 1d6 Cold damage and reduce Speed by 10 feet until your next turn.

ru.name: Морозный холод
ru.description: После попадания нанесите 1к6 холодом и снизьте скорость на 10 футов до следующего хода.

en.name: Hill’s Tumble
en.description: After a damaging hit, knock a Large or smaller target Prone.

ru.name: Падение холма
ru.description: После попадания сбейте большую или меньшую цель с ног.

en.name: Stone’s Endurance
en.description: Reaction when damaged: reduce the damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier.

ru.name: Каменная выносливость
ru.description: Реакцией при получении урона уменьшите его на 1к12 + модификатор Телосложения.

en.name: Storm’s Thunder
en.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet damages you: deal 1d8 Thunder damage to it.

ru.name: Гром бури
ru.description: Реакцией, когда существо в 60 футах наносит вам урон, нанесите ему 1к8 уроном звуком.

en.name: Large Form
en.description: From level 5, become Large for 10 minutes as a Bonus Action, gain Advantage on Strength checks, and increase Speed by 10 feet. Once per Long Rest.

ru.name: Большая форма
ru.description: С 5 уровня бонусным действием станьте большим на 10 минут, получите преимущество на проверки Силы и +10 футов скорости. Один раз до продолжительного отдыха.

en.name: Powerful Build
en.description: You have Advantage on checks to end Grappled and count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

ru.name: Мощное телосложение
ru.description: Вы совершаете с преимуществом проверки для окончания захвата и считаетесь на один размер больше при расчёте грузоподъёмности.

en.name: Brave
en.description: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened.

ru.name: Храбрость
ru.description: Преимущество на спасброски, чтобы избежать или окончить состояние «Испуган».

en.name: Halfling Nimbleness
en.description: Move through the space of creatures larger than you, but do not stop there.

ru.name: Проворство полурослика
ru.description: Перемещайтесь через пространство существ крупнее вас, но не останавливайтесь там.

en.name: Luck
en.description: When you roll a 1 on a d20 for a D20 Test, reroll it and use the new result.

ru.name: Удача
ru.description: Когда на к20 проверки выпадает 1, перебросьте кость и используйте новый результат.

en.name: Naturally Stealthy
en.description: You can Hide when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger.

ru.name: Природная скрытность
ru.description: Вы можете Спрятаться, даже если вас заслоняет только существо минимум на один размер крупнее.

en.name: Resourceful
en.description: Gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

ru.name: Находчивость
ru.description: Получайте Героическое вдохновение после каждого продолжительного отдыха.

en.name: Skillful
en.description: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

ru.name: Умелый
ru.description: Получите владение одним навыком на выбор.

en.name: Versatile
en.description: Gain one Origin feat of your choice.

ru.name: Разносторонний
ru.description: Получите одну черту происхождения на выбор.

en.name: Adrenaline Rush
en.description: Take Dash as a Bonus Action and gain Temporary HP equal to Proficiency Bonus. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Short or Long Rest.

ru.name: Выброс адреналина
ru.description: Совершите Рывок бонусным действием и получите временные хиты, равные БМ. Использований равно БМ до короткого или продолжительного отдыха.

en.name: Darkvision
en.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

ru.name: Тёмное зрение
ru.description: Вы обладаете тёмным зрением в пределах 120 футов.

en.name: Relentless Endurance
en.description: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead. Once per Long Rest.

ru.name: Непоколебимая стойкость
ru.description: Когда хиты снижаются до 0, но вы не погибаете сразу, оставьте 1 хит. Один раз до продолжительного отдыха.

effects.trigger: reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright

en.name: Darkvision
en.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

ru.name: Тёмное зрение
ru.description: Вы обладаете тёмным зрением в пределах 60 футов.

en.name: Abyssal Legacy
en.description: Resist Poison and learn Poison Spray; gain Ray of Sickness at level 3 and Hold Person at level 5.

ru.name: Наследие Бездны
ru.description: Сопротивляйтесь яду и изучите «Брызги яда»; на 3 уровне получите «Луч болезни», на 5 — «Удержание личности».

en.name: Chthonic Legacy
en.description: Resist Necrotic and learn Chill Touch; gain False Life at level 3 and Ray of Enfeeblement at level 5.

ru.name: Хтоническое наследие
ru.description: Сопротивляйтесь некротическому урону и изучите «Леденящее прикосновение»; на 3 уровне получите «Ложную жизнь», на 5 — «Луч слабости».

en.name: Infernal Legacy
en.description: Resist Fire and learn Fire Bolt; gain Hellish Rebuke at level 3 and Darkness at level 5.

ru.name: Инфернальное наследие
ru.description: Сопротивляйтесь огню и изучите «Огненный снаряд»; на 3 уровне получите «Адское возмездие», на 5 — «Тьму».

en.name: Otherworldly Presence
en.description: Know Thaumaturgy, using the spellcasting ability selected for Fiendish Legacy.

ru.name: Потустороннее присутствие
ru.description: Вы знаете «Чудотворство» и используете для него характеристику, выбранную для инфернального наследия.

en.name: Alert
en.description: Add Proficiency Bonus to Initiative; immediately after rolling Initiative, you may swap it with a willing ally who is not Incapacitated.

ru.name: Бдительный
ru.description: Добавляйте БМ к инициативе; сразу после броска можете обменяться инициативой с согласным союзником без состояния «Недееспособен».

en.name: Magic Initiate
en.description: Choose the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list, learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from it, choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, and cast the level 1 spell free once per Long Rest. Each repeat must use a different list.

ru.name: Посвящённый в магию
ru.description: Выберите список жреца, друида или волшебника, изучите два заговора и заклинание 1 уровня, выберите Интеллект, Мудрость или Харизму и раз в продолжительный отдых сотворяйте заклинание 1 уровня бесплатно. При повторе выбирайте другой список.

choices.filter: entityType == spell && spellLevel == 0 && spellClassIds contains selected("choice.magic-initiate.list")
entityType == spell && spellLevel == 1 && spellClassIds contains selected("choice.magic-initiate.list")

en.name: Savage Attacker
en.description: Once per turn on a weapon hit, roll the weapon damage dice twice and use either roll.

ru.name: Свирепый атакующий
ru.description: Раз в ход при попадании оружием бросьте его кости урона дважды и выберите результат.

effects.trigger: once per turn on weapon hit

en.name: Skilled
en.description: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

ru.name: Умелый
ru.description: Получите владение любой комбинацией трёх навыков или инструментов.

en.name: Ability Score Improvement
en.description: Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1, to a maximum of 20.

ru.name: Улучшение характеристик
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 2 или две на 1, максимум до 20.

en.name: Grappler
en.description: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (max 20); combine Unarmed Strike damage and grapple once per turn, gain Advantage against creatures you Grapple, and move same-size or smaller Grappled creatures without extra movement.

ru.name: Борец
ru.description: Увеличьте Силу или Ловкость на 1 (макс. 20); раз в ход совмещайте урон безоружного удара и захват, атакуйте захваченных с преимуществом и перемещайте захваченных своего размера или меньше без дополнительных затрат.

effects.trigger: once per turn as part of the Attack action

en.name: Archery
en.description: Gain +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

ru.name: Стрельба
ru.description: Получите +2 к броскам атаки дальнобойным оружием.

en.name: Defense
en.description: While wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, gain +1 Armor Class.

ru.name: Оборона
ru.description: Пока вы носите лёгкий, средний или тяжёлый доспех, получите +1 к КД.

en.name: Great Weapon Fighting
en.description: Treat 1 or 2 as 3 on damage dice for a Melee weapon held in two hands with Two-Handed or Versatile.

ru.name: Сражение большим оружием
ru.description: Считайте 1 или 2 на кости урона за 3 для рукопашного двуручного или универсального оружия, удерживаемого двумя руками.

en.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
en.description: Add your ability modifier to the extra attack from a Light weapon when it is not already added.

ru.name: Сражение двумя оружиями
ru.description: Добавляйте модификатор характеристики к дополнительной атаке лёгким оружием, если он ещё не добавлен.

en.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30). When an attack misses, make it hit instead; once until the start of your next turn.

ru.name: Дар боевого мастерства
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30). После промаха превратите его в попадание; один раз до начала следующего хода.

en.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30). After the Attack or Magic action, teleport up to 30 feet.

ru.name: Дар пространственного путешествия
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30). После действия «Атака» или «Магия» телепортируйтесь на 30 футов.

en.name: Boon of Fate
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30). After a D20 Test within 60 feet succeeds or fails, apply +2d4 or −2d4; recover after Initiative or a Short/Long Rest.

ru.name: Дар судьбы
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30). После успеха или провала проверки к20 в 60 футах примените +2к4 или −2к4; восстановление после инициативы, короткого или продолжительного отдыха.

effects.trigger: after a D20 Test within 60 feet succeeds or fails
effects.notes: Choose the rolled total as a bonus or penalty.

en.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
en.description: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (max 30), ignore Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and on a natural 20 deal extra damage equal to the increased ability score.

ru.name: Дар неудержимого нападения
ru.description: Увеличьте Силу или Ловкость на 1 (макс. 30), игнорируйте сопротивление дробящему, колющему и рубящему урону и при натуральной 20 наносите дополнительный урон, равный повышенной характеристике.

en.name: Boon of Spell Recall
en.description: Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1 (max 30). When casting with a level 1–4 slot, roll 1d4; matching the slot level preserves the slot.

ru.name: Дар возврата заклинания
ru.description: Увеличьте Интеллект, Мудрость или Харизму на 1 (макс. 30). При сотворении ячейкой 1–4 уровня бросьте 1к4; при совпадении с уровнем ячейка не тратится.

effects.trigger: after casting with a level 1-4 slot when 1d4 equals the slot level

en.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30). In Dim Light or Darkness become Invisible as a Bonus Action until you take an action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; also resist all damage except Psychic and Radiant there.

ru.name: Дар ночного духа
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30). В тусклом свете или тьме бонусным действием становитесь невидимым до действия, бонусного действия или реакции; там же сопротивляйтесь всему урону кроме психического и излучения.

en.name: Boon of Truesight
en.description: Increase one ability by 1 (max 30) and gain 60-foot Truesight.

ru.name: Дар истинного зрения
ru.description: Увеличьте одну характеристику на 1 (макс. 30) и получите истинное зрение 60 футов.

en.name: Dagger
en.description: Simple melee weapon: 1d4 Piercing; Finesse, Light, Thrown (20/60); Nick mastery.

ru.name: Кинжал
ru.description: Простое рукопашное оружие: 1к4 колющего урона; Фехтовальное, Лёгкое, Метательное (20/60); мастерство «Ник».

en.name: Arcane Focus (Staff)
en.description: An Arcane Focus that also functions as a Quarterstaff: 1d6 Bludgeoning, Versatile (1d8), Topple mastery.

ru.name: Магическая фокусировка (посох)
ru.description: Магическая фокусировка, также являющаяся боевым посохом: 1к6 дробящего урона, Универсальное (1к8), мастерство «Опрокидывание».

en.name: Robe
en.description: A four-pound robe with vocational or ceremonial significance.

ru.name: Мантия
ru.description: Четырёхфунтовая мантия профессионального или церемониального значения.

en.name: Spellbook
en.description: A Tiny, three-pound, 100-page object readable by its Wizard or by a creature using Identify. It stores the Wizard's level 1+ spells.

ru.name: Книга заклинаний
ru.description: Крошечный предмет весом 3 фунта на 100 страниц, читаемый владельцем-волшебником или существом под действием «Опознания». Хранит заклинания волшебника 1+ уровня.

en.name: Backpack
en.description: Holds up to 30 pounds in 1 cubic foot and can serve as a saddlebag.

ru.name: Рюкзак
ru.description: Вмещает до 30 фунтов в объёме 1 кубического фута и может служить седельной сумкой.

en.name: Book
en.description: A fiction or nonfiction book. An accurate nonfiction reference can aid relevant Intelligence checks.

ru.name: Книга
ru.description: Художественная или справочная книга. Точный справочник может помочь в соответствующих проверках Интеллекта.

en.name: Ink
en.description: A one-ounce bottle, enough for about 500 pages.

ru.name: Чернила
ru.description: Флакон в одну унцию, достаточный примерно для 500 страниц.

en.name: Ink Pen
en.description: Used with Ink to write or draw.

ru.name: Перо
ru.description: Используется с чернилами для письма и рисования.

en.name: Lamp
en.description: Burns Oil and casts Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for 30 additional feet.

ru.name: Лампа
ru.description: Сжигает масло, создавая яркий свет в радиусе 15 футов и тусклый ещё на 30 футов.

en.name: Oil Flask
en.description: One flask of Oil; usable as fuel or to create a burning hazard.

ru.name: Фляга масла
ru.description: Одна фляга масла; используется как топливо или для создания горящей области.

en.name: Parchment Sheet
en.description: One sheet holds about 250 handwritten words.

ru.name: Лист пергамента
ru.description: Один лист вмещает около 250 рукописных слов.

en.name: Tinderbox
en.description: A compact fire-starting kit.

ru.name: Огниво
ru.description: Компактный набор для разведения огня.

en.name: Scholar's Pack
en.description: A 22-pound pack containing a Backpack, Book, Ink, Ink Pen, Lamp, 10 flasks of Oil, 10 sheets of Parchment, and a Tinderbox.

ru.name: Набор учёного
ru.description: Набор весом 22 фунта: рюкзак, книга, чернила, перо, лампа, 10 фляг масла, 10 листов пергамента и огниво.

en.name: Calligrapher’s Supplies
en.description: Dexterity-based artisan’s tools used for guarded, decorative writing and crafting Ink or Spell Scrolls.

ru.name: Принадлежности каллиграфа
ru.description: Ремесленные инструменты на Ловкость для защищённого каллиграфического письма и создания чернил или свитков.

en.name: Holy Symbol
en.description: A divine spellcasting focus in amulet, emblem, or reliquary form.

ru.name: Священный символ
ru.description: Божественная фокусировка в виде амулета, эмблемы или реликвария.

en.name: Thieves’ Tools
en.description: Dexterity-based tools used to pick locks or disarm traps.

ru.name: Воровские инструменты
ru.description: Инструменты на Ловкость для вскрытия замков и обезвреживания ловушек.

en.name: Crowbar
en.description: Grants Advantage on Strength checks where leverage applies.

ru.name: Лом
ru.description: Даёт преимущество на проверки Силы, где применим рычаг.

en.name: Pouch
en.description: A small one-pound container.

ru.name: Сумка
ru.description: Небольшой контейнер весом один фунт.

en.name: Traveler’s Clothes
en.description: Resilient garments designed for travel.

ru.name: Дорожная одежда

en.name: Acid Arrow
en.description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 Acid damage and 2d4 Acid dam age at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage only. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage (both initial and later) increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 2.

en.name: Acid SplASh
en.description: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range, where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that Sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage. Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

en.name: Aid
en.description: Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target’s Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Each target’s Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

en.name: Alarm
en.description: You set an alarm against intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won’t set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is audible or mental: Audible Alarm. The alarm produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds within 60 feet of the warded area. Mental Alarm. You are alerted by a mental ping if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you’re asleep.

ru.name: Alarm

Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won’t set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is audible or mental: Audible Alarm. The alarm produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds within 60 feet of the warded area. Mental Alarm. You are alerted by a mental ping if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you’re asleep.

en.name: Alter Self
en.description: You alter your physical form. Choose one of the following options. Its effects last for the duration, during which you can take a Magic action to replace the option you chose with a different one. Aquatic Adaptation. You sprout gills and grow webs between your fingers. You can breathe under water and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. Change Appearance. You alter your appear ance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You can’t appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same; if you’re bipedal, you can’t use this spell to become quadrupedal, for instance. For the duration, you can take a Magic action to change your appearance in this way again. Natural Weapons. You grow claws (Slashing), fangs (Piercing), horns (Piercing), or hooves (Blud geoning). When you use your Unarmed Strike to deal damage with that new growth, it deals 1d6 damage of the type in parentheses instead of deal ing the normal damage for your Unarmed Strike, and you use your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls rather than using Strength.

en.name: Animal Friendship
en.description: Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spells ends. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.

en.name: Animal Messenger
en.description: A Tiny Beast of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw, or it attempts to deliver a message for you (if the target’s Challenge Rating isn’t 0, it automatically succeeds). You specify a location you have visited and a recipient who matches a general descrip tion, such as “a person dressed in the uniform of the town guard” or “a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat.” You also communicate a message of up to twenty-five words. The Beast travels for the duration toward the specified location, covering about 25 miles per 24 hours or 50 miles if the Beast can fly. When the Beast arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, mimicking your communication. If the Beast doesn’t reach its desti nation before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the Beast returns to where you cast the spell. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The spell’s dura tion increases by 48 hours for each spell slot level above 2.

en.name: Animal Shapes
en.description: Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. Each target shape-shifts into a Large or smaller Beast of your choice that has a Challenge Rating of 4 or lower. You can choose a dif ferent form for each target. On later turns, you can take a Magic action to transform the targets again. A target’s game statistics are replaced by the chosen Beast’s statistics, but the target retains its creature type; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; alignment; ability to communicate; and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target’s actions are lim ited by the Beast form’s anatomy, and it can’t cast spells. The target’s equipment melds into the new form, and the target can’t use any of that equipment while in that form. The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the first form into which it shape-shifts. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends. The trans formation lasts for the duration or until the target ends it as a Bonus Action.

en.name: Animate Dead
en.description: Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid within range. The target becomes an Undead creature: a Skeleton if you chose bones or a Zombie if you chose a corpse (see “Monsters” for the stat blocks). On each of your turns, you can take a Bonus Ac tion to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you’ve given it. To maintain control of the creature for an other 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the crea ture again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating a new creature. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You animate or reassert control over two additional Undead crea tures for each spell slot level above 3. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.

en.name: Animate Objects
en.description: Objects animate at your command. Choose a num ber of nonmagical objects within range that aren’t being worn or carried, aren’t fixed to a surface, and aren’t Gargantuan. The maximum number of objects is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; for this number, a Medium or smaller target counts as one object, a Large target counts as two, and a Huge target counts as three. Each target animates, sprouts legs, and becomes a Construct that uses the Animated Object stat block; this creature is under your control until the spell ends or until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each creature you make with this spell is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count and takes its turn immediately after yours. Until the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 500 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. When the creature drops to 0 Hit Points, it reverts to its object form, and any remain ing damage carries over to that form. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The creature’s Slam damage increases by 1d4 (Medium or smaller), 1d6 (Large), or 1d12 (Huge) for each spell slot level above 5. en.name: Antilife Shell
en.description: An aura extends from you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. The aura prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reach ing through it. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with Ranged or Reach weapons through the barrier. If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.

en.name: Antimagic Field
en.description: An aura of antimagic surrounds you in 10-foot Em anation. No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura, and those things can’t target or otherwise affect any thing inside it. Magical properties of magic items don’t work inside the aura or on anything inside it. Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can’t extend into the aura, and no one can teleport into or out of it or use planar travel there. Portals close temporarily while in the aura. Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn’t function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration. Dispel Magic has no effect on the aura, and the au ras created by different Antimagic Field spells don’t nullify each other.

en.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
en.description: As you cast the spell, choose whether it creates antipathy or sympathy, and target one creature or object that is Huge or smaller. Then specify a kind of creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. A creature of the chosen kind makes a Wisdom saving throw when it comes within 120 feet of the target. Your choice of antipathy or sympathy deter mines what happens to a creature when it fails that save: Antipathy. The creature has the Frightened condi tion. The Frightened creature must use its move ment on its turns to get as far away as possible from the target, moving by the safest route. Sympathy. The creature has the Charmed condi tion. The Charmed creature must use its move ment on its turns to get as close as possible to the target, moving by the safest route. If the creature is within 5 feet of the target, the creature can’t willingly move away. If the target damages the Charmed creature, that creature can make a Wisdom saving throw to end the effect, as de scribed below. Ending the Effect. If the Frightened or Charmed creature ends its turn more than 120 feet away from the target, the creature makes a Wisdom sav ing throw. On a successful save, the creature is no longer affected by the target. A creature that suc cessfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.

en.name: Arcane Eye
en.description: You create an Invisible, invulnerable eye within range that hovers for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which can see in every direction. It also has Darkvision with a range of 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. A solid barrier blocks the eye’s movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

en.name: Arcane Hand
en.description: You create a Large hand of shimmering magical en ergy in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand. The hand is an object that has AC 20 and Hit Points equal to your Hit Point maximum. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends. The hand doesn’t oc cupy its space. When you cast the spell and as a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can move the hand up to 60 feet and then cause one of the following effects: Clenched Fist. The hand strikes a target within 5 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 Force damage. Forceful Hand. The hand attempts to push a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or the hand pushes the target up to 5 feet plus a number of feet equal to five times your spellcasting ability modifier. The hand moves with the target, re maining within 5 feet of it. Grasping Hand. The hand attempts to grapple a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw, or the target has the Grappled condition, with an escape DC equal to your spell save DC. While the hand grapples the target, you can take a Bonus Action to cause the hand to crush it, dealing Blud geoning damage to the target equal to 4d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Interposing Hand. The hand grants you Half Cover against attacks and other effects that originate from its space or that pass through it. In addi tion, its space counts as Difficult Terrain for your enemies. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage of the Clenched Fist increases by 2d8 and the damage of the Grasping Hand increases by 2d6 for each spell slot level above 5.

en.name: Astral Projection
en.description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell ends instantly if you are already on that plane). Each target’s body is left behind in a state of suspended animation; it has the Unconscious condi tion, doesn’t need food or air, and doesn’t age. A target’s astral form resembles its body in almost every way, replicating its game statistics and pos sessions. The principal difference is the addition of a silvery cord that trails from between the shoulder blades of the astral form. The cord fades from view after 1 foot. If the cord is cut—which happens only when an effect states that it does so—the target’s body and astral form both die. A target’s astral form can travel through the As tral Plane. The moment an astral form leaves that plane, the target’s body and possessions travel along the silver cord, causing the target to re-enter its body on the new plane. Any damage or other effects that apply to an as tral form have no effect on the target’s body and vice versa. If a target’s body or astral form drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends for that target. The spell ends for all the targets if you take a Magic action to dismiss it. When the spell ends for a target who isn’t dead, the target reappears in its body and exits the state of suspended animation.

en.name: Awaken

en.name: Clone
en.description: You touch a creature or at least 1 cubic inch of its flesh. An inert duplicate of that creature forms inside the vessel used in the spell’s casting and fin ishes growing after 120 days; you choose whether the finished clone is the same age as the creature or younger. The clone remains inert and endures indef initely while its vessel remains undisturbed. If the original creature dies after the clone fin ishes forming, the creature’s soul transfers to the clone if the soul is free and willing to return. The clone is physically identical to the original and has the same personality, memories, and abilities, but none of the original’s equipment. The creature’s original remains, if any, become inert and can’t be revived, since the creature’s soul is elsewhere.

en.name: Control Weather
en.description: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors. When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the GM. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal. When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction. en.name: Create Undead
en.description: You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range. Each one becomes a Ghoul under your control (see “Monsters” for its stat block). As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same com mand to them). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular place. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature con tinues to follow the order until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you’ve given it. To maintain control of the creature for an other 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the crea ture before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to three creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating new ones. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you use a level 7 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over four Ghouls. If you use a level 8 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five Ghouls or two Ghasts or Wights. If you use a level 9 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six Ghouls, three Ghasts or Wights, or two Mummies. See “Monsters” for these stat blocks.

en.description: You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shad owfell to create an object within range. en.description: You create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glow ing orbs that hover for the duration. en.name: Darkness
en.description: For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can’t see through it, and nonmagical light can’t illuminate it. Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn’t being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness. If any of this spell’s area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

en.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
en.description: A beam of yellow light flashes from you, then con denses at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration. When the spell ends, the bead explodes, and each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes Fire damage equal to the total accumulated damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The spell’s base damage is 12d6, and the damage increases by 1d6 whenever your turn ends and the spell hasn’t ended. If a creature touches the glowing bead before the spell ends, that creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the spell ends, causing the bead to explode. On a successful save, the creature can throw the bead up to 40 feet. If the thrown bead enters a creature’s space or collides with a solid ob ject, the spell ends, and the bead explodes. When the bead explodes, flammable objects in the explosion that aren’t being worn or carried start burning. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The base damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 7.

en.name: Demiplane
en.description: You create a shadowy Medium door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. This door can be opened and closed, and it leads to a demiplane that is an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone (your choice). When the spell ends, the door vanishes, and any objects inside the demiplane remain there. Any creatures inside also remain unless they opt to be shunted through the door as it vanishes, landing with the Prone condition in the unoccupied spaces closest to the door’s former space. Each time you cast this spell, you can create a new demiplane or connect the shadowy door to a demiplane you created with a previous casting of this spell. Additionally, if you know the nature and contents of a demiplane created by a casting of this spell by another creature, you can connect the shad owy door to that demiplane instead.

en.description: You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns. Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don’t read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present. The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead. Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the tar get’s mind right now. If the target doesn’t know any languages and isn’t telepathic, you learn nothing. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target’s mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

en.name: Dimension Door
en.description: You teleport to a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as “200 feet straight downward” or “300 feet upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle.” You can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you tele port, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space. System Reference Document 5.2.1 If you, the other creature, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature trav eling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.

You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. On a successful save, the target takes half as much dam age only. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage in creases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

en.name: Divination
en.description: This spell puts you in contact with a god or a god’s servants. You ask one question about a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The GM of fers a truthful reply, which might be a short phrase or cryptic rhyme. The spell doesn’t account for cir cumstances that might change the answer, such as the casting of other spells. If you cast the spell more than once before finish ing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

en.name: Divine Word
en.description: You utter a word imbued with power from the Up per Planes. Each creature of your choice in range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target that has 50 Hit Points or fewer suffers an effect based on its current Hit Points, as shown in the Divine Word Effects table. Regardless of its Hit Points, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend target that fails its save is forced back to its plane of origin (if it isn’t there already) and can’t return to the current plane for 24 hours by any means short of a Wish spell. Divine Word Effects 0–20 - The target dies. 21–30 - The target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions for 10 minutes. 31–40 - The target has the Blinded, Deafened, and Stunned conditions for 1 hour. 41–50 The target has the Deafened condition for 1 minute.

en.name: Dominate Beast
en.description: One Beast you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target has Advan tage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. You have a telepathic link with the Charmed tar get while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as “Attack that creature,” “Move over there,” or “Fetch that object.” The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn’t re ceive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself. You can command the target to take a Reaction but must take your own Reaction to do so. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Your Concentra tion can last longer with a spell slot of level 5 (up to 10 minutes), 6 (up to 1 hour), or 7+ (up to 8 hours)

en.name: Dragon’s Breath
en.description: You touch one willing creature, and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. Until the spell ends, the target can take a Magic action to exhale a 15-foot Cone. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage in creases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2

en.name: Dream
en.description: You target a creature you know on the same plane of existence. You or a willing creature you touch enters a trance state to act as a dream messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is Incapacitated and has a Speed of 0. If the target is asleep, the messenger appears in the target’s dreams and can converse with the tar get as long as it remains asleep, through the spell’s duration. The messenger can also shape the dream’s environment, creating landscapes, objects, and other images. The messenger can emerge from the trance at any time, ending the spell. The target re calls the dream perfectly upon waking. If the target is awake when you cast the spell, the messenger knows it and can either end the trance (and the spell) or wait for the target to sleep, at which point the messenger enters its dreams. You can make the messenger terrifying to the tar get. If you do so, the messenger can deliver a mes sage of no more than ten words, and then the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains no benefit from its rest, and it takes 3d6 Psychic damage when it wakes up.

en.name: Druidcraft
en.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range. Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sen sory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round. Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom. Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory ef fect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube. Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire

en.name: Earthquake
en.description: Choose a point on the ground that you can see within range. For the duration, an intense tremor rips through the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle centered on that point. The ground there is Difficult Terrain. When you cast this spell and at the end of each of your turns for the duration, each creature on the ground in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the Prone condition, and its Concentration is broken. You can also cause the effects below. Fissures. A total of 1d6 fissures open in the spell’s area at the end of the turn you cast it. You choose the fissures’ locations, which can’t be under struc tures. Each fissure is 1d10 × 10 feet deep and 10 feet wide, and it extends from one edge of the spell’s area to another edge. A creature in the same space as a fissure must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall in. A creature that successfully saves moves with the fissure’s edge as it opens. Structures. The tremor deals 50 Bludgeoning damage to any structure in contact with the ground in the area when you cast the spell and at the end of each of your turns until the spell ends. If a structure drops to 0 Hit Points, it collapses. A creature within a distance from a collapsing structure equal to half the structure’s height makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the crea ture takes 12d6 Bludgeoning damage, has the Prone condition, and is buried in the rubble, requiring a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check as an action to es cape. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

en.name: Eldritch Blast
en.description: You hurl a beam of crackling energy. Make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object in range. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage. Cantrip Upgrade. The spell creates two beams at level 5, three beams at level 11, and four beams at level 17. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.

en.name: Elementalism
en.description: You exert control over the elements, creating one of the following effects within range. Beckon Air. You create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all in a 5-foot Cube. Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren’t affected. Beckon Earth. You create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area, or you cause a single word to appear in your handwrit ing in a patch of dirt or sand. Beckon Fire. You create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5-foot Cube. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area. The smoke’s scent lingers for 1 minute. Beckon Water. You create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube. Alternatively, you create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface, and the water evaporates in 1 minute. Sculpt Element. You cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1-foot Cube to assume a crude shape (such as that of a creature) for 1 hour

en.name: Enhance Ability
en.description: You touch a creature and choose Strength, Dex terity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. For the duration, the target has Advantage on ability checks using the chosen ability. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. You can choose a different ability for each target.

en.name: Enlarge/Reduce
en.description: For the duration, the spell enlarges or reduces a creature or an object you can see within range (see the chosen effect below). A targeted object must be neither worn nor carried. If the target is an un willing creature, it can make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the spell has no effect. Everything that a targeted creature is wearing and carrying changes size with it. Any item it drops returns to normal size at once. A thrown weapon or piece of ammunition returns to normal size imme diately after it hits or misses a target. Enlarge. The target’s size increases by one cat egory—from Medium to Large, for example. The target also has Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target’s attacks with its enlarged weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit. Reduce. The target’s size decreases by one cate gory—from Medium to Small, for example. The tar get also has Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target’s attacks with its reduced weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 less damage on a hit (this can’t reduce the damage below 1)

en.name: Ensnaring Strike
en.description: As you hit the target, grasping vines appear on it, and it makes a Strength saving throw. A Large or larger creature has Advantage on this save. On a failed save, the target has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the vines shrivel away, and the spell ends. While Restrained, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage in creases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

en.name: Entangle
en.description: Grasping plants sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into Difficult Terrain. They disappear when the spell ends. Each creature (other than you) in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself from the grasping plants and is no longer Restrained by them.

en.name: Enthrall
en.description: You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range to make a Wisdom saving throw. Any crea ture you or your companions are fighting automati cally succeeds on this save. On a failed save, a target has a −10 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks and Passive Perception until the spell ends.

en.name: Etherealness
en.description: You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration. During this time, you can move in any direction. If you move up or down, every foot of movement costs an extra foot. You can perceive the plane you left, which looks gray, and you can’t see anything there more than 60 feet away. While on the Ethereal Plane, you can affect and be affected only by creatures, objects, and effects on that plane. Creatures that aren’t on the Ethereal Plane can’t perceive or interact with you unless a feature gives them the ability to do so. When the spell ends, you return to the plane you left in the spot that corresponds to your space in the Border Ethereal. If you appear in an occupied space, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take Force damage equal to twice the number of feet you are moved. This spell ends instantly if you cast it while you are on the Ethereal Plane or a plane that doesn’t border it, such as one of the Outer Planes. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target up to three willing creatures (including yourself) for each spell slot level above 7. The creatures must be within 10 feet of you when you cast the spell.

en.name: Expeditious Retreat
en.description: You take the Dash action, and until the spell ends, you can take that action again as a Bonus Action.

en.name: Eyebite
en.description: For the duration, your eyes become an inky void. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration. On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to target another creature but can’t target a creature again if it has succeeded on a save against this casting of the spell. Asleep. The target has the Unconscious condition. It wakes up if it takes any damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake. Panicked. The target has the Frightened con dition. On each of its turns, the Frightened target must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest and shortest route available. If the tar get moves to a space at least 60 feet away from you where it can’t see you, this effect ends. Sickened. The target has the Poisoned condition.

On each of its turns, the Frightened target must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest and shortest route available. If the tar get moves to a space at least 60 feet away from you where it can’t see you, this effect ends. Sickened. The target has the Poisoned condition.

en.name: Fabricate
en.description: You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, or clothes from flax or wool. Choose raw materials that you can see within range. You can fabricate a Large or smaller object (contained within a 10-foot Cube or eight connected 5-foot Cubes) given a sufficient quantity of mate rial. If you’re working with metal, stone, or another mineral substance, however, the fabricated object can be no larger than Medium (contained within a 5-foot Cube). The quality of any fabricated objects is based on the quality of the raw materials. Creatures and magic items can’t be created by this spell. You also can’t use it to create items that require a high degree of skill—such as weapons and armor—unless you have proficiency with the type of Artisan’s Tools used to craft such objects.

en.name: Find Familiar
en.description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: Bat, Cat, Frog, Hawk, Lizard, Octopus, Owl, Rat, Raven, Spider, Weasel, or another Beast that has a Challenge Rating of 0. Appearing in an unoccupied space within range, the familiar has the statistics of the chosen form (see “Monsters”), though it is a Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice) instead of a Beast. Your familiar acts independently of you, but it obeys your commands. Telepathic Connection. While your familiar is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it telepathically. Additionally, as a Bonus Action, you can see through the familiar’s eyes and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn, gaining the benefits of any special senses it has. Finally, when you cast a spell with a range of touch, your familiar can deliver the touch. Your fa miliar must be within 100 feet of you, and it must take a Reaction to deliver the touch when you cast the spell. Combat. The familiar is an ally to you and your allies. It rolls its own Initiative and acts on its own turn. A familiar can’t attack, but it can take other actions as normal. Disappearance of the Familiar. When the famil iar drops to 0 Hit Points, it disappears. It reappears after you cast this spell again. As a Magic action, you can temporarily dismiss the familiar to a pocket dimension. Alternatively, you can dismiss it forever. As a Magic action while it is temporarily dismissed, you can cause it to reappear in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. Whenever the familiar drops to 0 Hit Points or disappears into the pocket dimen sion, it leaves behind in its space anything it was wearing or carrying. One Familiar Only. You can’t have more than one familiar at a time. If you cast this spell while you have a familiar, you instead cause it to adopt a new eligible form.

If you already have a steed from this spell, the steed is replaced by the new one. The steed resembles a Large, rideable animal of your choice, such as a horse, a camel, a dire wolf, or an elk. Whenever you cast the spell, choose the steed’s creature type—Celestial, Fey, or Fiend— which determines certain traits in the stat block. Combat. The steed is an ally to you and your al lies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count, and it functions as a controlled mount while you ride it (as defined in the rules on mounted combat). If you have the Incapacitated condition, the steed takes its turn immediately after yours and acts inde pendently, focusing on protecting you. Disappearance of the Steed. en.name: Find the Path
en.description: You magically sense the most direct physical route to a location you name. You must be familiar with the location, and the spell fails if you name a desti nation on another plane of existence, a moving des tination (such as a mobile fortress), or an unspecific destination (such as “a green dragon’s lair”). For the duration, as long as you are on the same plane of existence as the destination, you know how far it is and in what direction it lies. Whenever you face a choice of paths along the way there, you know which path is the most direct.

en.name: Find Traps

A trap, for the purpose of this spell, in cludes any object or mechanism that was created to cause damage or other danger. Thus, the spell would sense the Alarm or Glyph of Warding spell or a mechanical pit trap, but it wouldn’t reveal a natural weakness in the floor, an unstable ceiling, or a hid den sinkhole. This spell reveals that a trap is present but not its location. You do learn the general nature of the dan ger posed by a trap you sense.
